changelog:
- Initial release of the gumtree-uk-pets skill for bb-browser.
- Enables searching and comparing UK pet classifieds on Gumtree, structured in JSON with image support.
- Supports animals (dogs, cats, small furries, reptiles, horses) and pet equipment listings, limited to the Pets category.
- Enforces UK legal and Gumtree policy compliance for responsible use.
- Requires bb-browser and includes setup instructions for search and listing adapters.
- Read-only: does not support posting ads or contacting sellers directly.
